cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(robot_lab_rmf_graph_fix)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rmf_traffic REQUIRED)
find_package(rmf_building_map_msgs REQUIRED)
add_library(robot_lab_rmf_graph_fix SHARED convert_graph_fix.cpp)
target_compile_features(robot_lab_rmf_graph_fix PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(robot_lab_rmf_graph_fix rmf_traffic::rmf_traffic)
ament_target_dependencies(robot_lab_rmf_graph_fix rmf_building_map_msgs)
install(TARGETS robot_lab_rmf_graph_fix LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
